name: Can adjusting my sliding door help with energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: Can adjusting my sliding door help with energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a properly adjusted sliding door can significantly improve your home's energy efficiency. When a door is misaligned, it can create gaps where conditioned air escapes and outside air infiltrates, leading to higher energy bills. Adjusting the door ensures a tight seal, reducing drafts and preventing heat loss in winter or heat gain in summer. This helps maintain consistent indoor temperatures and lowers energy consumption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, proper adjustment ensures a tight seal, reducing drafts and improving energy efficiency by preventing air leakage.
